description: Validate any postal address in 240+ countries against authoritative reference data. Returns standardised address, rooftop coordinates, confidence score (A-F), and UDPRN + UPRN for UK addresses.

country.description: ISO 3-letter country code (preferred, e.g. `gbr`, `usa`, `deu`, `fra`). ISO-2 also accepted.

input.description: Single-line address — paste the whole address as one string, e.g. `10 Downing Street, London, SW1A 2AA`. Provide this OR the fielded inputs below.

state.description: State / region — required for USA, CAN, AUS, BRA, MEX.

name: validate_address
title: Validate Address
